messages:
maya: heads-up: enterprise prospect Z asked for three launch items for the console observability surface: fine-grained per-route cost, automatic error fingerprinting, and a per-tenant tracing hook that can be toggled. can we scope for GA?
diego: cost UI is highest ROI. backend aggregation + UI tile doable in one sprint if we limit retention and rollup granularity.
sam: fingerprinting is trickier because we need a normalization pass and small dedupe store. doable as an opt-in beta.
li: tracing hook can be a lightweight shim: feature flag + low-rate sampling (0.25%->1%) per-tenant. need perf tests.
infra-bot: ci-checklist updated: https://redwood.internal/ci/obs/17361 :white_check_mark:
maya: proposal: prioritize order: (A) cost tile MVP, (B) fingerprint beta, (C) trace-hook proto. deliverable targets: screenshots + staging endpoint after 2 sprints.
diego: implementation notes for cost MVP: aggregate tokens and GPU-ms per route, estimate $ via cost model. keep model-agnostic default. retention 30d, rollups hourly. UI: top-20 routes, export CSV.
sam: fingerprint design: hash(normalized_stack + normalized_inputs) -> fingerprint_id. store sample_count, last_seen_ts, one example payload. retention 14d. expose sample endpoint to fetch examples.
li: gating criteria: cost tile accuracy: top-95% traffic within 5% of billing; fingerprints: dedupe rate >50% on test dataset; trace hook: end-to-end added latency <1ms @ p95.
maya: owner assignments: @diego cost tile, @sam fingerprints, @li trace hook. I'll own customer comms and screenshots.
diego: i'll add tickets to the board and break into backend/frontend tasks. linking design RFC shortly.
sam: prototyping fingerprint normalizer now. sharing schema in the ticket.
li: drafting perf harness and feature-flag plan. recommend toggles at org-level and route-level.
maya: quick decision: keep cost widget model-agnostic for GA; record quantization and model overrides as a follow-up.
diego: ack. we'll add a note in UI copy and in the doc.
sam: sample fingerprint payload (sanitized): {
  "route": "/v1/chat",
  "stack_signature": "SIG_9f1b",
  "norm_keys": ["prompt_shape", "user_locale"],
  "tokens": 412
}
maya: perfect. i'll loop in prospect Z for quick feedback on the mock and get approval for the beta. schedule a 30min sync post-sprint-planning. infra-bot: calendar event created 1736110000. :calendar:
